instruction: Enable the automatic suspend feature so the computer goes to sleep after a period of inactivity when plugged in.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic suspend when on AC power by setting org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power sleep-inactive-ac-type to 'suspend'. Evaluator verifies the setting value using gsettings get command.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the AC power suspend setting using 'gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power sleep-inactive-ac-type'
